['Enovos Energie Deutschland GmbH '].company_description: Enovos Energie Deutschland GmbH is a company that operates in the energy sector, focusing on electricity networks and natural gas pipelines in the Grand Duchy of Luxembourg. The company plans, constructs, and maintains high, medium, and low-voltage electricity networks and high, medium, and low-pressure natural gas pipelines.

['Sto SE & Co. KGaA '].company_description: Sto SE & Co. KGaA operates in the field of facade insulation systems, offering products such as crack-resistant and impact-resistant insulation systems, non-combustible facades with mineral flush and polystyrene, ceramic, and multi-faceted glass facades under the brand names StoTherm, StoVentec, and StoSolar.
